title: Canal Towpath Walks
desc: Flat, easy walking along the Forth & Clyde Canal from Kirkintilloch toward Bishopbriggs, Kilsyth, and the wider towpath network.

title: Town Hall to Auld Kirk Loop

title: Marina & Waterside Days
desc: Bring in the calmer side of Kirkintilloch with Auchinstarry Marina, waterside pauses, and easy nature stops.
